correctness.rationale: D=GP(10,2), 20 cubic vertices with exactly 6 distance-two vertices per root. A 3-set covers at most 9 vertices by adjacency, leaving at least 11 needing >=22 distance-two incidences, but only <=18 available. Four-sets q^{-1}(ab) for each of 15 Petersen quotient edges are valid by two-lift path arguments and meet the minimum. Independently enumerated all 4845 4-sets via exact distance-2 DTD predicate: precisely 15 and equal to antipodal edge lifts. Distinct lifts have 0 or 2 vertices in common; 1-exchange graph is edgeless and 2-exchange graph is Petersen line graph, 30 edges and all-vertex eccentricity three. Finite state exhaustion is a full fixed-graph proof.
